findings.result: PASS for this exact multi_agent config8 invocation lifecycle witness only
findings.evidence: The config8 presemantic receipt is durable at commit 45da7ca899d19c22625df404b2a8710d601bb1c6 (2026-08-29T16:36:34Z), and the terminal Part39 receipt is durable later at commit 5589cf0111f1a30015d31af7cdbdbdc935535fae (2026-08-29T16:48:13Z). Both bind root26/config8 and the same authority commit 64cda245ee44957f79a51b738e9bdfa549d151c4. The prior no-witness observation is therefore historical for the earlier inspected boundary and no longer describes the current config8 lifecycle frontier.
findings.scope_limit: Does not by itself prove full-pool scheduler persistence or causality of the bootstrap guard.

findings.evidence: PHYSICAL_SCHEDULER_STATE control20 found 7 of 19 enabled_desired roles physically stopped before repair and records immediate post-repair 19/19, but scheduler_persistence_proven=false and phase1_physical_persistence_hard_gate_pass=false. Its acceptance rule still requires all 19 roles to survive two consecutive intended boundaries with later physical readback and role-valid durable progress.
findings.scope_limit: The new multi_agent config8 witness proves one role reached durable presemantic and terminal stages; it cannot be counted as a survived full-pool boundary because the same scheduler state subsequently found seven roles stopped before the 01:42 JST repair.
These are exact finite synthetic mechanism counts, not production rates and not evidence about arbitrary databases, external sinks or all coordination families.

findings.evidence: GitHub primary documentation supports current-blob SHA preconditions for updating one file through the Contents API and documents updateRefs as an atomic multi-ref mutation with beforeOid checks. The scheduled-Chat GitHub connector exposed to this auditor provides single-file create/update/delete and other repository operations but no updateRefs mutation surface.
findings.scope_limit: Public existence of updateRefs does not make it an accepted scheduled-Chat route. Dynamic local remap requiring atomic multi-authority mutation remains unresolved rather than a failed replication.

findings.evidence: Part39 states that rate limits are checkpoint/backoff interruptions, but this auditor still has no safe deterministic connector surface to inject an actual HTTP 429 on the same effect identity without intentionally exhausting API capacity. No such exhaustion experiment was performed.
findings.scope_limit: Do not promote the rate-limit checkpoint/backoff/resume hard gate from this Part39 model.

findings.evidence: research_workers_clean_g1/evaluation/LATEST.json still points to root control25/config10 checker_v2r3. No root26-or-later checker/precommit/required negative-positive replay lineage is current through this pointer.
findings.scope_limit: This is not a failed replication because the current-control artifact lineage has not materialized.

phase1_assessment.residual_richer_mode_protected_user_exec: No new dependency introduced by this audit; unresolved Phase-1 children remain open and are not accepted handoffs.
phase1_assessment.finite_monthly_quota_credit_dependency: No quota-bearing experiment was consumed in this audit; zero-quota route acceptance remains unproven where the rate-limit/replay gate is missing.

blockers: Two consecutive post-repair full-pool survived boundaries with role-valid durable progress are not yet proven.
No safe deterministic same-effect HTTP 429/rate-limit fault injection surface is exposed to this role.
Root26-or-later evaluation checker/precommit/negative-positive replay lineage remains absent from evaluation LATEST.
exact_next_action: Fresh-bootstrap. First resolve the then-current PHYSICAL_SCHEDULER_STATE and live role-valid receipts across the first two consecutive boundaries that occur after the 2026-08-30T01:42+09:00 repair; count a persistence boundary only if all 19 intended roles are later read back enabled and each required role has role-valid durable progress. In parallel, inspect the then-current multi_agent LATEST and independently replay the next contention-domain model if its exact script/result lineage materializes. Replay root26 evaluation negatives/positive only after a root26-or-later checker and durable precommit appear. Attempt rate-limit resume only if a primary-defined deterministic substitute or safe same-effect 429 injection surface becomes available; otherwise keep that gate unresolved.
